evidence.scope: nominal carrier fit and sampled removal; current complete assembly still excludes several parts and has no physical retention

evidence.label: forearm integrated assembly

evidence.scope: nominal geometry and service sequence; populated hardware and physical retention open

evidence.label: fastener catalog
evidence.scope: candidate fasteners and interfaces; no material/process data

evidence.label: Printable first fit specimens
evidence.scope: Nominal CAD/STL exports, fit and negative controls only; physical and powered checks not_run

evidence.label: Rejected taller fixed collars
evidence.scope: 33 mm baseline fails new clearance envelope; 40–58 mm candidates show actual head/face interference. Stops at first failure; service remains unrun.

evidence.label: Recovered head-owned cap stock
evidence.scope: Full-depth and 8 mm stock rejected by actual sampled neck-mechanism collisions. No attachment or physical qualification.

evidence.label: Local rear-wing relief
evidence.scope: Pip/Scout v3 pass 37 sampled clearance screens each; unmounted and physically untested, with incomplete protection coverage.

evidence.label: Ribbed head-cap attachment stock
evidence.scope: Nominal stock fits but selected rear mounts fail the moving allowance, confirmed by exact 0.6385/0.1213 mm gaps. Front Scout eye obstruction and fastening/service/physical gates remain.

evidence.label: Integral lower-head wings
evidence.scope: Two replacement shell halves per robot; nominal joins, 37 motion samples and 12 conditional removal offsets pass. Tools, cables, physical qualification and main assembly integration remain open.

evidence.label: Revised head tool access
evidence.scope: Straight driver fails two rear Pi screws; right-angle key allocation passes sampled seated, withdrawal and exterior angular checks. Detached Pi stage; bridge, harness and physical qualification remain not_run.

evidence.label: Head bridge assembly order
evidence.scope: Four bearing witnesses, two seated drivers, twenty vertical samples and forty-six staged checks pass per robot. Closed-head wrench/axial nut routes fail; physical, harness and retention aid remain open.

evidence.label: Removable shin-cover candidate
evidence.scope: Ten sampled poses plus mutual hardware and removal checks pass; physical, continuous and complete robot qualification remain open.

bench.purpose: Validate printed holes, inserts, bearing seats, connector keep-outs and repeatable service.
bench.setup: Print shell, actuator-ear, board-post and insert coupons in intended process/orientations; use actual fasteners and tools.
bench.measurements: CAD-versus-part dimensions, torque, pull-out/rotation, clearance, wear and service-cycle count.
bench.acceptance: Provisional: all dimensions and clearances recorded against the drawing; no cracking, insert spin or fastener strip during the agreed cycle. Limits remain provisional until material/process is selected.
bench.prerequisites: Selected print process, fasteners/inserts, calipers, torque tool and force gauge.

areas.next_build: Print the first fit specimens, record process and dimensions, and compare one actual actuator and installed inserts; see docs/design/first-fit-bench.md.
blockers: No measured insert or fastener retention
Neck/head protection needs a moving-cap design; raising the fixed collar fails motion/clearance checks.
Relieved lower-head wings need verified attachment stock, fasteners, removal and complete protection coverage.
Selected head-cap mount stock has insufficient moving clearance; revise tab/fastener geometry together, with Scout front eye packaging still unresolved.

evidence.scope: 14-component atopile candidate and 64 static divider checks; initial pump sizing failure retained. Controller transient, hardware stop, layout, thermal and physical qualification not_run.

bench.purpose: Verify rails, startup, transients, harness drop, thermal rise and fault behavior with real parts.
bench.setup: One XH logic board, controlled 9 / 12.6 V source, 1.92308 ohm cold-load fixture, separate 3.125 ohm + 1 A warm-step fixture and simultaneous voltage/current capture. Follow the linked procedure before using the actual Pi/camera. Motor and fault benches are separate.
bench.measurements: Rail voltage/current, startup/brownout/recovery, connector/harness drop, regulator/board temperature and fault response.
bench.acceptance: Provisional 4.75–5.25 V output window; preserve the entire startup and check cold whole-trace overvoltage plus final regulation after 8 ms. Record failed boot/resets separately. Thermal acceptance remains undefined pending component and enclosure budget.
bench.prerequisites: Fabricated/populated board, harness, supply, oscilloscope, load bank and thermocouples.

areas.next_build: One populated XH board and measured load fixture, then the actual computer/camera with raw startup and runtime capture.

bench.purpose: Measure end-to-end transport and prove local stop/timeout behavior on a supported rig.
